evidence.functional_evidence: After the fix, take_and_close completes on devnet: T paid 5 of mint B, received 10 of mint A, and the vault and state closed (33yMgZzA…). Refund still works (script 3qwx8QBC…; UI 3GUdvNGQ… and 2GsfGiPt…). Before, on program 6Z5cvVUc…, take aborted with an access violation (ck53TqoU…). The token-dropdown query-key bug is also fixed: the hosted-build click-through listed 18 tokens including mint A and mint B, then created an escrow (2c6QNtYz…) and refunded it.

(The list is fetched once on connect, so the harness reloads after create/cancel to show the new card.) take_and_close was proven by the script (33yMgZzA…); no open foreign escrow was left to Accept in this click-through.

limitations: The earlier college program 6Z5cvVUc… (unfixed take) is still on devnet but is no longer the hosted app; its failing take is ck53TqoU… (access violation). This entry is the fixed program 45C1bSkF….
The Create form's token dropdown was empty because useWalletTokens used walletAddress?.toBase58 (the function) in the query key; this hosted build uses the base58 string.
The card still mentions a GFT token reward; the program has no reward-mint instruction (navbar read only).
The escrow list is fetched once when the wallet connects and does not auto-refresh after Create or Cancel; a reload shows the new or closed card. This is a UX gap, not a broken create/refund/take.
